prompts.image2d: Use case: style-transfer. Create a TWO-DIMENSIONAL HAND-DRAWN character turnaround from image 1, not a CG image or filtered photograph. Image 1 is authoritative for this exact character's identity, face, mature age direction, proportions, pose, costume, colors, accessories, limb count and all three view details. Image 2 is ONLY a drawing-style reference: refined controlled dark ink linework, subtle line weight, restrained cel color blocks, soft illustrated volume and fine faint paper texture. Do not copy bull identity horns or clothes from image 2. Preserve the original species and existing degree of anthropomorphism, not a redesign. Landscape 3:2 sheet: left full front, center full side, right full back, same scale and baseline, ample margins including full antennae/antlers/wing tips/feet. Warm pale beige paper backdrop with subtle drawn contact shadow. Crisp detailed line-art drawn fur/feathers and fabric folds, clearly non-photoreal and non-3D. No labels text watermark panels scenery extra people. White duck security guard, orange broad bill, navy security jacket trousers cap, shoulder radio, waist keys and flashlight, white feathered wing-hands, dark shoes and short duck tail.
prompts.image3d: Use case: stylized-concept. AstralPact animal-world character design. Create ONE landscape 3:2 character turnaround sheet of the SAME character: left front view, center side view, right back view, equal scale, aligned feet, complete head feet tail and wings with generous space. Plain warm light gray beige studio backdrop, natural contact shadow. Image 1 is ONLY rendering quality reference: high-end feature-film 3D CGI, physically based materials, crisp natural detail, soft key and subtle cool fill; do NOT copy dragon identity, horns, jewelry or royal clothes. Image 2 ONLY reference for series anthropomorphic working-person proportions, practical worn clothing and three-view presentation; do NOT copy pigeon species, helmet or courier backpack. Mature dignified everyday worker, expressive animal face, not baby/chibi, not caricature of stupidity or misery. Fine individual fur/feathers where appropriate, woven cloth, believable seams and restrained material highlights. All three angles consistent anatomy clothing accessories. No text, labels, logos, watermark, scenery, extra characters. Middle-aged male anthropomorphic white duck, broad orange duck bill, slightly tired but calm attentive dark eyes, stocky upright adult proportions. Navy blue security guard jacket and matching trousers, plain peaked security cap no insignia text, shoulder radio, black utility belt with keys and small flashlight, black practical shoes fitted to webbed feet, articulated feathered wing-hands resting at sides. Subtle wear at cuffs. No weapon, no military medals, no police emblem. Short duck tail visible.
